about: Inkling 2 Mini (26B looped MoE, ~3B active, vision, thinking) UD-Q4_K_XL with the F16 vision projector on one RTX 4090 24GB, everything on the GPU, no draft model. The full 131,072-token window fits with f16 KV, the default ubatch and CUDA graphs on: the server takes 23,078 MiB at ready, and the whole card peaked at 23,298 of 24,564 MiB over two gate runs. -bs (backend sampling, experimental in this build) samples on the GPU: on this card it lifts decode from about 69.5 to 72.7 tok/s (median of 6 per run, three interleaved runs each way) with prefill unchanged. llama.cpp from Unsloth's prebuilt b12588-mix-c0c3de8 (unslothai/llama.cpp 8832860, CUDA 13 portable): the Inkling 2 architecture is not in a ggml-org release yet. One slot, flash attention at its default, Thinking Machines' recommended sampling. At this window on 24 GB, the DSpark draft, q8_0 KV and -ub 1024 do not fit; the draft loads with -ub 256 but decodes slower (48-60 tok/s, 15-28% of drafts accepted) and the server then aborts on a long prompt (cudaGraphInstantiate out of memory).
setup: Not Docker; Linux x86-64 with an NVIDIA driver for CUDA 13. Unpack the archive into llama-b12588-mix-c0c3de8/ next to models/ and run from that directory. The archive does not bundle the CUDA runtime: put libcudart.so.13, libcublas.so.13 and libcublasLt.so.13 (PyPI nvidia-cuda-runtime 13.3.29 and nvidia-cublas 13.5.1.27) in cuda13-runtime/ and install libgomp1, or the server fails to load its CUDA backend.
